notes.ownership: Source of truth lives in TrackMuleBB (bundled default); this pages copy is the optional REMOTE OVERRIDE the setup CLI refreshes from, so the product set can change without a TrackMuleBB release.
notes.controller: TrackMuleBB is the single capability-driven controller + suite installer; it drives the installed core via /api/v1 capability negotiation. aMuTorrent is deprecated (legacy-only inside the frozen 0.7.3 bundle).
